detail: Ask for the Tax Payment Record (纳税记录) through the electronic tax bureau, the tax administration's mobile app or a tax service hall. It covers income from 2019 on that was reported, whether or not tax was paid. For earlier years the office issues the older paper certificate (税收完税证明).

action: Match the deposits to the record
detail: Go through the bank statement. A deposit that appears on the record with tax paid is settled: the bank asks for exactly this evidence.

action: Sort what is left into a case
detail: For each unmatched deposit decide whether it is one of the nine taxable kinds of income, and whether somebody should have withheld.

action: Work out the tax and the surcharge
detail: Apply the rate for that kind of income. Add 0.05% of the tax for every day since the deadline.

action: File and pay before the tax office asks
detail: File the missing return yourself. Refusing to file after the office has told you to is evasion, which has no time limit; not filing on your own is not evasion.

action: Get the fine decided in writing
detail: The fine is a range, not a number. Ask the tax office which multiple it applies and get the decision on paper. To dispute it you first pay or give a guarantee.

action: Take the updated record to the bank
detail: With your passport and the documents showing where the money came from. Then follow the route on the dashboard for that kind of money.
For every year: was the income on your Form 1040, was the bank interest on it, and was an FBAR filed when the accounts together passed $10,000?

action: Pick one U.S. procedure before filing anything
detail: Use the table above. The streamlined procedures stop being available once the IRS opens an examination.

action: Claim the credit for the Chinese tax
detail: On Form 1116, for the income tax only. The surcharge and the fine are not creditable.
